nodes.description: Disease-causing germline ABCA1 variants impair the ATP-binding cassette transporter required for apolipoprotein-mediated cellular lipid export. Human genetic studies identified ABCA1 mutations in Tangier disease kindreds, and cell-based studies show that ABCA1 promotes phospholipid and cholesterol efflux by loading apoA-I with lipids.
